title: Mangetsu
tagline: We are creating a privacy-preserving cross chain amm/dex using zero knowledge proof.
description: For this hackathon, our scope will be to focus on disconnecting inputs and outputs of each trade by offering privacy. That is, if a trader deposits coin A in order to exchange for coin B, our protocol will ensure that the link between the two coins would not be apparent in the eyes of the public and this will be done using zkp.
how_its_made: We are still researching as to how we can incorporate the privacy feature in question. That said, a friend of ours has worked on an amm partially by resorting to the basic mechanism adopted by tornado cash v2, and we hope to bring improvement to this privacy feature in particular for utxo coins during this hackathon.
